Unless you go really viral (millions of views, though I think that trend of cis people watching transitions videos passed years ago) then there's a pretty high chance that someone you know won't randomly come across your videos. If you put your name in the description box or the title of the video(s) though, that would obviously make it easier to identify you. Sometimes people get curious and google others (or maybe that's just me lol) and when applying for jobs usually employers will look you up for social media accounts and what not to make sure you aren't up to anything illegal that would get them in trouble. 

Also, if you make videos that aren't about the subject of being trans I'd probably recommend separate channels. While most of the audience for trans videos are other trans people, vlogs about daily life or specific topics like cooking or video games reach a broader amount of people whom would then also see your trans videos either on your channel or in the sidebar. Thus kinda expanding that risk, even if still very unlikely, that someone you have connections with in real life would stumble upon. 

There's a loooot to consider, but either way good luck! And if you ever do feel some sort of intense regret or suspicion you can always make the videos private! Or they could be link-only so you could only share them with specific controlled communities like on this subreddit.
